method: All 856 fresh inputs read in full twice. Residual retrieval uses char_wb 4–5 gram TF-IDF, min_df=2, max_features=250000; top five neighbours >=.25 per fresh input across 7683 distinct protected IDs and fresh inputs. All 1464 distinct not-already-linked component pairs reviewed by named incident/title and relevant available dates/excerpts; 49 already-linked pairs and duplicate component pairs carried through. Explicit cross-language/event bridges added from full source reading. This is retrieval and manual grouping, not a sentiment predictor.
limits: Not exhaustive semantic or pretraining-overlap detection. Some campaign/season/extended-conflict components are deliberately broad and sacrifice supply. Distinct unrelated incidents sharing a city, actor, genre or article template are not automatically joined. No labels or candidate errors used to choose group membership.
